SET decide_frame_limit=3; SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'A', 1, 4, 5), (2, 'A', 1, 4, NULL), (3, 'A', 2, 6, 1), (4, 'B', 1, 7, 3)) t(id, product, period, v, w) DECIDE x(INT)
        SUCH THAT x <= 9 MAXIMIZE when t.id <= 2: at(previous else t.w: x) over (t.period within t.product)
